intro.en: AICC is the internal consulting and innovation lab of the Bank for the adoption of artificial intelligence. It explores and proves the use of AI with the functions of the Bank, delivers measured outcomes, and sets the way in which the Bank adopts AI at scale, with accountability that stays with people.

AICC serves the functions of the Bank. A function brings a need, AICC commits to an Engagement, delivers a Solution with its evidence, and supports it at the agreed level. The Business Model states the offer, and the Engagement workflow shows how a function works with AICC.
intro.ru: Раздел описывает услуги, которые AICC предоставляет функциям Банка, решения, которые он создаёт, и порядок обращения функции в AICC.

intro.en: AICC works by one method: Initiatives are taken in and decided in the Portfolio, Solutions are delivered, released, and operated through the Solution Lifecycle, and the work runs on a common cadence and is measured. The workflows show the flow, and the guides explain it.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает метод AICC: как принимаются и решаются инициативы, как создаются, выпускаются и эксплуатируются решения, как организован ритм работы и как она измеряется. Процессы показывают ход работы, руководства поясняют его.

intro.en: AICC is a joint team, led by the AICC Lead and formed of the people whom the functions of the Bank assign to it. Seven Roles carry the work, decisions are taken at defined levels, and the Steering and the Board Committee advise and oversee. The charter names Roles; the persons who hold them are recorded in the Appointments Record of the Registry.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает роли AICC, уровни принятия решений и органы, которые консультируют и решают. Лица, исполняющие роли, названы в Журнале назначений Реестра; устав называет только роли.

intro.en: The Bank uses AI under rules that are proportionate to risk. Each Solution has a Risk Tier, is checked or validated before use, and is overseen by people who can stop it. The AI Policy states the rules, the Risk Tiers, the review of providers, the handling of AI Incidents, and the Exceptions, within the AI Risk Appetite Statement of the Bank.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает правила использования ИИ в Банке: уровни риска, проверки и валидацию перед использованием, оценку поставщиков, обработку инцидентов ИИ и исключения. В нём есть ссылки на Заявление о риск-аппетите ИИ и на контрольные точки поставки.

intro.en: AICC is controlled, reported, and assured through five control loops, a catalogue of thirty-two controls, and the records that evidence them. The AICC Lead reports each quarter, the Executive Sponsor issues the report to the Board Committee, and internal audit gives independent assurance. The status of each control at a date is kept in the Control Matrix of the Registry.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает, как осуществляются контроль, отчётность и обеспечение уверенности в AICC: контуры контроля, записи и свидетельства, каталог контролей и отчётность перед комитетом совета. Статус каждого контроля на дату ведётся в Матрице контролей Реестра.

intro.en: The thirteen templates are the forms of the records that AICC produces, from the Initiative Brief to the Quarterly Report. A template gives the form; the rules for the record are in the documents.
intro.ru: Раздел содержит тринадцать шаблонов: формы записей, которые ведёт AICC. Шаблон задаёт форму, а правила ведения записи изложены в документах.

intro.en: The Vocabulary defines the terms of the charter, the Document Catalog lists its documents, the change history records their revisions, and Records and systems states where each record is kept.
intro.ru: Раздел содержит Словарь, Каталог документов, историю изменений документов и страницу, которая указывает, где хранится каждая запись.

eyebrow.en: Charter and governance of the unit

lead.en: The mission of AICC is to enable the Bank to adopt AI as a governed capability that delivers measured value. This site is the charter of AICC: its intent, its method, its organization, and its controls.
lead.ru: Миссия AICC состоит в том, чтобы позволить Банку использовать ИИ как управляемую возможность, которая приносит измеримую ценность. Этот сайт является уставом AICC: его намерения, метод, организация и контроли.

en.title: What AICC does

en.title: How AICC works

en.title: How AICC is safeguarded

ru.title: Что делает AICC
ru.text: Исследует, пробует и доказывает применение ИИ вместе с функциями и предлагает, что Банку внедрять в масштабе.

ru.title: Как работает AICC
ru.text: Принимает инициативы, принимает по ним решения, создаёт решения и измеряет поток работы.

ru.title: Как обеспечена безопасность
ru.text: Устанавливает правила использования, назначает уровни риска, контролирует и отчитывается.

text.en: To make artificial intelligence a trusted, everyday capability of the Bank: to prove its value with the functions that serve our customers, to set the standard by which the Bank adopts it, and to keep every use of it accountable to people, so that the Bank serves its customers better, works with greater confidence, and leads with care.

AICC is an internal consulting and innovation lab of the Bank. It explores, trials, and proves the use of AI with the functions, delivers the outcome, and proposes what the Bank should adopt at scale. It works as a consulting unit does: it engages with a function on a defined scope, delivers an outcome with its evidence, and keeps its commitments and its records in order.

AICC exists to enable the Bank to adopt AI as a governed capability that delivers measured value. The adoption improves the quality, speed, and consistency of the operations and services of the Bank, and serves its mission to improve people's lives with digital products and services. The direction is clear: from governed foundations, through assistants and embedded AI, to bounded agents under human oversight, with accountability for every Solution with a named individual.

The Bank pursues seven Strategic Priorities, from customer intelligence to software engineering, each resting on a governed foundation of people, data, and a shared AI Platform. Each Strategic Priority advances at its own pace through five Maturity Levels, and a level is reached when its Measures are met.

A function brings a need to AICC. AICC takes it in as an Initiative, probes it first as a minimum viable product, measures it against defined success Measures, and extends it only on that evidence. The work is visible, limited in progress, and paced by a common cadence. Before a Solution reaches its users, it is checked or validated by a person other than its builder, accepted by the Team, and accepted by the Domain Owner who asked for it. AICC applies this way of working to itself and is the example of what it proposes to the Bank.

AICC acts under the mandate of the Executive Sponsor, whom the Board names. It does not own or operate the AI Platform, own the business results of a Domain, set the rules of a Control Function, or validate its own work. The Control Functions stay independent and may stop a Solution, and internal audit gives assurance only. The AICC Lead reports each quarter, and the Board oversees AI through the Board Committee.

Each Solution is assigned a Risk Tier, which sets the review, validation, human oversight, and speed of release that apply to it. The Bank accepts risk from AI where the benefit is measured and the controls are proportionate, and it does not accept a breach of law or regulation.
Three values guide the work: integrity, prudence, and respect for people. The principles of adoption, application, work, and delivery follow from them.

intro.en: The values and principles of AICC follow the values of the Bank and the Statement of Intent on the adoption of artificial intelligence. They state what AICC stands for, how it decides, and how it delivers. AICC holds itself to them first, and asks the same of every Solution it proposes to the Bank.

applies.en: Three values guide every decision of AICC: integrity, prudence, and respect for people. They are the values on which the Bank adopts AI, and AICC is their first keeper. Where speed and value compete with them, the values prevail.

AICC adopts AI where it earns its place. These principles decide where AI is introduced, where it is extended, and where it is withdrawn, so that the Bank invests in what works and learns from what does not.

Every use of AI in the Bank answers to these principles, whether AICC built it or not. They are the commitment the Bank makes to its customers, its employees, its regulators, and its auditors: accountable, fair, explainable, private, secure, overseen by people, and compliant.
This is how AICC runs itself: close to the facts, quick to reverse, light on process, and measured by outcomes. AICC is the example of the way of working that it proposes to the Bank.

This is how the Teams of AICC build: visible, in small steps, value first, with quality and control built into the flow rather than added after it. Working Solutions and evidence count more than documents and opinion.

text.en: To make artificial intelligence a trusted, everyday capability of the Bank: to prove its value with the functions that serve our customers, to set the standard by which the Bank adopts it, and to keep every use of it accountable to people, so that the Bank serves its customers better, works with greater confidence, and leads with care.
